shouldFix.title: Assigned abdce147 G01/G02 pin unauthorized binary-byte conversions of D-006 MB numerals, and G02 leaves installed-tree accounting open
shouldFix.detail: D-006 decides G01 at 25 MB, G02 at 80 MB, and G04 at 40/50/60/100 MB, and does not define MB as 1,000,000 or 1,048,576 bytes. The assigned object nevertheless turns G01 into 26214400 bytes and G02 into 83886080 bytes. Those constants are 25×2^20 and 80×2^20. They are not in D-006, D-102, or file 08. D-102 defines GiB as bytes/1024^3 only for RAM matching. The same conversion is not applied to G04. Separately, 'installed-tree size in bytes' never fixes logical file lengths versus allocated blocks, metadata/xattrs, links, or deduplicated inventory nodes. Prompt attack 'invented byte constants remain' therefore lands on the assigned bytes. Prompt claimed disposition CGHS-V1-SF1 is not landed on those bytes.
shouldFix.impact: Two conforming implementations can disagree on G01/G02/G04 pass/fail while both claim to implement D-006. OBL-2 cannot close on these bytes.
shouldFix.requiredRepair: If the assigned abdce147 object is restored, route one reviewed D-006 unit/accounting clarification that keeps the adopted 25/80/40/50/60/100 numerals and defines the byte unit consistently for G01, G02, and G04, and define G02's installed-tree accounting domain. Then reproduce only the resulting authorized arithmetic. If no successor decides those semantics, remove the invented byte constants and keep OBL-2 open. Do not invent that conversion inside an independent-review cycle. Do not execute a harness and do not choose a new threshold numeral here.

shouldFix.title: Assigned abdce147 G03 no-load half and G04 RSS quantities are labels, not closed measurement protocols
shouldFix.detail: D-102 governs fleet labels, N=21, ranks, cold/warm ordering, path identity, native-architecture preflight, and paired regression. It does not define a non-vacuous component/project-load fixture or an RSS observation method. The assigned object does not supply either missing layer. G03 asks for a 'process/module trace proving no component or project load' without pinning a discoverable component, a project, cwd/environment, event classes, or a classification rule. Running --help/--version where no component or project exists therefore passes vacuously. G04 asks for steady and peak traces plus a 'raw methodology record' but never defines the OS primitive, process-tree scope, sample window, peak/steady derivation, or unit conversion. Prompt attacks 'G03 no-load is still vacuous' and 'G04 RSS is still a label' land. Claimed dispositions CGHS-V1-SF2 are not landed on the assigned bytes.
shouldFix.impact: The timing half can follow D-102, but the no-load and RSS halves admit mutually incompatible passing harnesses. G03/G04 are not independently executable specifications.
shouldFix.requiredRepair: For G03, pin a non-vacuous available-component and project fixture, initial cwd/environment/discovery state, retained event stream, and a closed rule that distinguishes access/load/spawn from mere availability. For G04, specify the per-platform RSS primitive, process scope, sample timing/window, steady and peak derivations, unit conversion, and retained raw observations while preserving D-102's N=21/order/preflight contract and D-006's exclusions. Do not ptrace or suspend a timing sample. Do not run the fixture, change the D-102 fleet, or add analyze/consented-probe bounds.

shouldFix.title: Assigned abdce147 G05 makes publication mandatory but never defines comparable start/RSS deltas
shouldFix.detail: D-006 requires per-component download/install/start/RSS visibility and defers numeric caps. The assigned object invents no cap. Its only semantic requirement is four published numbers 'each with methodology and the core baseline they subtract from.' It does not identify the component-enabled workload, the paired core-only workload, start endpoints, RSS scope/quantity, repetition/aggregation, or the subtraction formula. The cited G03/G04 core baselines are --help/--version and doctor-read-only; they are not a comparable TypeScript-provider start or RSS workload, and analyze RSS is outside D-006/G04. Prompt attack 'G05 start/RSS deltas are still unpublished methodology' lands. Claimed disposition CGHS-V1-SF3 is not landed on the assigned bytes.
shouldFix.impact: G05 visibility is nominal rather than independently verifiable. Publishers can report incomparable values while still passing the absence-only rule.
shouldFix.requiredRepair: Define a digest-pinned paired core-only versus component-enabled workload for start and RSS, exact start endpoints, RSS process/quantity semantics, sample/aggregate rule, and delta formula; bind each published delta to those inputs and raw observations. Keep download/install byte deltas exact and per platform. Preserve the no-cap standing and keep this G05 workload separate from D-006's exclusion of analyze and consented-probe RSS from G04. Do not choose a cap or execute the harness.
